mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 73 degrees with overcast skies over at Verona Community Park.

In city news, a former teacher was arrested for sexual assault of a child following an investigation into events from 2019. Additionally, residents should be aware of shifting traffic patterns near the new Aldi site and the upcoming closure of the Military Ridge State Trail for bridge repairs.

We have plenty to look forward to including trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia options at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.

Regarding local law enforcement, the department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they began an investigation into an inappropriate relationship involving a school staff member, leading to an arrest last week.
Today at Culver's, enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight.
